parsed.reason: This message fails on multiple counts. It includes greeting ("Hi there!"), emoji, and exclamation mark - all marked LOW. It names the other household ("A family near you with a toddler") which is explicitly forbidden. It asks two questions instead of one. It includes an invented specific (a deadline: "within 2 days") and points at an app/link (www.example.com). Most critically, it never states what "covered" means - it never explains that Hale will keep watching dates on its own AND that the parent can text a parenting question whenever they need to. The message only asks for a name and email, with no indication of what Hale actually does from here. This reads like a company collecting contact details rather than a tail that completes the meaning of "you're covered."
